title: apply_esm_change
description: Approved ESM configuration change with Before/After preview and undo. changeType: cpqSetting or enrichQuoteOption (target=setting name, value), generalSetting, pricingPlanStep (fieldsJson name, sequence, implementation, method, parameters, active; recordId to update), contextRule (fieldsJson name, ruleset, product, expression, failureMessage; created inactive), contextRuleset, attributeBinding (Quote Member Binding: attribute, objectClass, fieldApiName), linearRelationship (product, relatedProduct, relationshipType), record (allow-listed ESM objects), undo (target=change log CL-...). ALWAYS mode=preview, show the Approval card, wait for an explicit yes, then mode=commit with previewToken and the same inputs. Never pass secrets (keys) – they go through the secure Codey Setup page.

mode.description: preview (default) or commit after the person approved.

changeType.description: cpqSetting, enrichQuoteOption, generalSetting, pricingPlanStep, contextRule, contextRuleset, attributeBinding, linearRelationship, record or undo.

target.description: Setting name, object API name (record) or change log CL-... (undo).

fieldsJson.description: JSON with the fields for record changes.

previewToken.description: Token from the preview, for commit.

confirmProduction.description: true only if the person confirmed a production change.

message.description: Plain-language result to tell the person.

previewToken.description: Returned by a preview; pass it back with mode=commit and the same inputs only after the person approved.

fix.description: How to resolve a problem when success is false.
